    <div>
      <h1>The Transition Plan — Task-Level Checklist Across Five Blocks</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">The operational transition plan: every task owned, dated, and evidenced, organized by phase, ready to load into a delivery tracker on day one.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-08-transition-planning-checklist</b><br>
      Pack G - The plan we leave with<br>
      fill order <b>10</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>
      audience <b>mixed</b>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>Planning the Transition</b>, <i>Transition Planning Template</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook\ch08-planning-the-transition.qmd</code> L257-308 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch08-planning-the-transition.html#sec-transition-planning-template">#sec-transition-planning-template</a>
  </div>
  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Use the completed roadmap, pilot contract and baseline plan. For each task, tick only when done; name one individual; record a real date for Pre-Transition and evidence a third party can inspect. Keep later-phase dates provisional until the baseline plan is captured, then keep them within the roadmap band. Record the evidence artifact, status, any blocker or reason for “not applicable,” and confirm the kit sheet or name the local artifact. The executive sponsor signs this day-one page; name the transition lead above.
  </div>

<div class="sheet">
  <div class="ws-head"><div><h1>The Transition Plan — Task-Level Checklist Across Five Blocks</h1><p class="ws-sub">The operational transition plan: every task owned, dated, and evidenced, organized by phase, ready to load into a delivery tracker on day one.</p></div><div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-08-transition-planning-checklist</b><br>Pack G - The plan we leave with<br>fill order <b>10</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>audience <b>mixed</b></div></div>
  <div class="ws-source">Source: <b>Planning the Transition</b>, <i>Transition Planning Template</i> &middot; <code>handbook\ch08-planning-the-transition.qmd</code> L257-308 &middot; <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch08-planning-the-transition.html#sec-transition-planning-template">#sec-transition-planning-template</a></div>
  <div class="ws-instruction">Name one individual per task. Keep every later-phase date provisional until the baseline plan is captured, then keep dates within the roadmap band. Record inspectable evidence, its artifact reference, status, any blocker or reason for “not applicable,” and confirm the kit sheet or name the local artifact. Provisional dates are not commitments.</div>
  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Phase 2 — Expand <span class="ws-block-note">9 tasks</span></h2><p class="ws-block-note">Fixed block choices: Pre-Transition &middot; Phase 1 — Pilot &middot; Phase 2 — Expand &middot; Phase 3 — Scale &middot; Ongoing</p>
    <p class="ws-block-note">Date status: PROVISIONAL and locked until WS-08-baseline-measurement-plan is captured; then bound by this phase's range on WS-08-transition-roadmap.</p>
    <p class="ws-block-note">For every “not applicable” status, write the reason in “Blocked by, or reason not applicable.” Evidence of done means the thing itself, not “completed.”</p>

  <div class="ws-head"><div><h1>The Transition Plan — Task-Level Checklist Across Five Blocks</h1><p class="ws-sub">The operational transition plan: every task owned, dated, and evidenced, organized by phase, ready to load into a delivery tracker on day one.</p></div><div class="ws-meta"><b>WS-08-transition-planning-checklist</b><br>Pack G - The plan we leave with<br>fill order <b>10</b> &middot; type <b>checklist</b><br>audience <b>mixed</b></div></div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">Name one individual per task. Keep every later-phase date provisional until the baseline plan is captured, then keep dates within the roadmap band. Record inspectable evidence, its artifact reference, status, any blocker or reason for “not applicable,” and confirm the kit sheet or name the local artifact. Provisional dates are not commitments.</div>
